title: AlPO$_{4}$-54 Structure
comments:
We take the label AlPO$_{4}$-54 from (Withers, 2005). 
 Related structures can be found on the \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{silica and aluminum phosphate page}. 
 The (12k) and (24l) sites are a 50-50 mixture of aluminium and phosphorous. We arbitarily label them as aluminum.
